title: SegmentedButton
description: Fiori segmented button (single or multiple selection) with arrow-key navigation and one tab stop.

usage.summary: Switch related view or setting options in a connected group.
useWhen: Let users switch related options such as Year, Month and Day within the same view.
Keep every segment visible and use labels that fit the available horizontal space.
Use selectionMode="multiple" when users may activate any combination of segments; use single for one selection.
Give each icon-only segment a tooltip and an accessible label.

avoidWhen.when: Present mutually exclusive form answers rather than change a view or setting.
Collapse 2–12 predefined options because their labels do not fit a horizontal group.
Navigate distinct content sections rather than change the current view or setting.
Activate or deactivate one independent toolbar action.
Run an explicit action such as Save rather than select an option.
